Name: Glaceon Pokemon as Cat
Author: Halfwheat
Description:
*UPDATED 2/19/2024 for content patcher*

This mod changes your cat to a Glaceon. Sprites taken from Pokemon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Time/Darkness. I do not have the spriting ability to make these myself :P

Check out my profile for more Pokemon mods!

INSTALLATION

1. Install ContentPatcher and SMAPI.

2. Download the mod.

3. Place the mod in your Mods folder in C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods

Let me know if anyone is having any problems with the sprite or if there are any stray pixels!
